source: Roboflow Universe, kaid-al "welding defect final0" v1 (YOLOv8 export), CC BY 4.0; reference [22] of the paper
purpose: Per-file integrity reference for the source distribution. Image and label files themselves are not redistributed here; this manifest lets a reader confirm that a copy obtained from the original source is byte-identical to the one audited.
how_to_verify: Download the archive from the URL in reference [22], then run scripts/make_source_manifest.py --verify. It recomputes every per-file MD5 and reports any path that is missing, extra, or different.
